summary.root_cause_text: ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; the worker processed orders without payment.
recommended: Validate that the payments-v2 endpoint is reachable before retrying the migration.
Add an alert on payment provider failures, which are logged only at DEBUG.
Make the worker fail or requeue orders when payment fails, instead of marking them processed.

root_causes: ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; the worker processed orders without payment.

DEBUG payment: provider call failed: payment provider unreachable at internal://payments-v2 (440x)
alert: 10 of 27 orders without payment; unpaid grew to 449 by reprocess time
args.impact: The unpaid backlog grew from 10 orders at alert time to 449 before the fix. All 449 were reprocessed and paid, with no failures. money_recovered was SAR 72315.74 and USD 39247.44, total_sar 219493.64. The initial alert showed total_sar 4400.81 for the first 10 orders.
recommended_actions: Validate that the payments-v2 endpoint is reachable before retrying the migration.
Add an alert on payment provider failures, which are logged only at DEBUG.
Make the worker fail or requeue orders when payment fails, instead of marking them processed.
args.summary: The ops config change to payments-v2 made the payment provider unreachable, so orders were processed without payment. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all 449 unpaid orders. All invariants are green now.
